tolerance_summary.guidance: Wall-to-wall dimensions of the same nominal wall differ by 0-50 mm between flats (median 20 mm). Treat any dimension in the model as nominal +/- 25 mm, and never design a fit that depends on less than about 30 mm of slack. !! QUALIFIED 2026-09-04: that band is flat-to-flat SCATTER and is symmetric. Separately, the developer plan reads LARGER than all three measured flats on both dimensions testable from printed chains (+1.0% to +1.9%, 9 of 9 comparisons) - so the risk is asymmetric. Size for a room up to ~100 mm SHORTER than drawn. See developer_vs_measured_linear_2026_09_04, including its unresolved tension with the area table.
tolerance_summary.area_guidance: Room areas agree within 0.1-0.3 m2 across the comparables; the totals differ by up to 2.4 m2 (68.3 to 70.7) and that is dominated by how the loggia is counted, not by the rooms.
tolerance_summary.biggest_outlier: RESOLVED. The туалет difference is a clear-vs-gross convention (developer deducts the вентблок, measured plans do not): 1140 x 1090 clear + 1140 x 490 вентблок = 1.80 m2, which two of three measured flats print. kv109's smaller 1.6 m2 is a floor effect - flats above the 10th floor carry a second ventilation section. This flat is on the 4th floor, so the single-section geometry and the larger areas apply.
tolerance_summary.use_which_comparables: kv53 and Минина 6 for this flat. kv109 is a different sub-type; keep it as evidence of the floor effect, not as a sample of the expected size.

caveats: The comparables are as-built plans of other flats in the same series, not of this flat.

measurement_conventions.developer_plan: clear (net) floor area, service boxing deducted
measurement_conventions.measured_bti_plans: gross floor area to wall faces, boxing counted as floor
measurement_conventions.rule: Never compare a developer area with a measured area directly. Where they differ by roughly the footprint of a service короб, that is the explanation before any construction difference is.
measurement_conventions.affects: туалет most (0.56 m2 of a 1.8 m2 room), ванная a little (~0.15), прихожая a little (~0.3). Living rooms have no risers and agree within 0.1.

wc_resolution.question: туалет reads 1.24 m2 on the developer plan and 1.6-1.9 m2 on every measured plan.
wc_resolution.answer: Different conventions, not different rooms. The developer publishes the CLEAR floor area with the стояки boxed out; the measured (БТИ-style) plans publish the GROSS area to the wall faces, counting the короб as floor.
wc_resolution.conclusion: 1140 x 1090 = 1.24 clear, plus the 1140 x 490 recess = 1.80 - which lands on the 1.8 and 1.9 of two of the three measured flats. The usable floor really is about 1.24 m2.
services_in_that_corner: вентблок с каналами (в туалете) - three channels drawn in section
стояки водоснабжения и канализации are also in the wet zone, position not yet pinpointed on the plan
wc_resolution.attribution: Explanation from the apartment owner; the arithmetic above is the check, and it agrees.
wc_resolution.consequence: Plan the туалет against ~1.24 m2 of usable floor, not 1.8. The короб is not removable - the стояки are common property and serve the whole riser.
wc_resolution.open_question: kv109 reads 1.6 m2, which is 0.2 below the other two. Either a smaller recess or a different sub-type; unresolved.
wc_resolution.correction_2026_08_26: The 1140 x 490 recess in the туалет is the ВЕНТБЛОК, not the plumbing короб. Zooming into the developer's plan shows a grey block with three rounded channels in section - the ventilation shaft with its satellite ducts - and not the circles that would draw water risers. The area arithmetic is unaffected (1.24 clear + 0.56 = 1.80 gross); what changes is which service is responsible.

floor_dependency.statement: Flats above the 10th floor carry TWO ventilation sections where the lower floors carry one - in the туалет and again between the kitchen zone and the laundry/hallway zone. The second section takes additional floor area.
floor_dependency.this_flat: 4th floor - one section, so the larger of the observed areas applies
floor_dependency.explains: kv109 printing туалет 1.6 m2 and a 68.3 m2 total against kv53's 1.9 and 70.7: consistent with kv109 being a higher-floor flat with the doubled vent block.
floor_dependency.confidence: owner's account, consistent with the measured spread; not independently verified against a section drawing
floor_dependency.plumbing_note: The plumbing riser zone is identical in every flat per the owner - only ventilation varies with floor.

wc_resolution.precision_caveat_2026_08_26: The 1.24 m2 used in the arithmetic is the DETAILED plan's figure. The developer's BASIC plan - the one actually traced in Homestyler - prints 1.42 m2 for the same туалет. With 1.42 the clear-plus-вентблок sum is 1.98 rather than 1.80, so the match to the measured 1.8/1.9 is suggestive rather than exact. The conclusion stands qualitatively: the measured plans count the вентблок zone and the usable floor is roughly 1.2-1.4 m2. The exact figure does not.

registration.purpose: Transform between the raster plans and CAD millimetres, so the images can be used as tracing surfaces.

basic_plan.note: Worse fit, but the residual is a thin fringe along every wall - a scale/offset error, not a geometric difference. The basic plan is a smaller, simpler drawing and registers less precisely.

registration.use: Register against the DETAILED plan even though the BASIC plan was the tracing base in Homestyler: it is the more accurate target and the two describe the same flat.

source_provenance_2026_09_04.statement: Owner, 2026-09-04: these five images are ALL the geometry that exists. fllor_plan_detailed.jpeg and floor_plan_basic.jpg are the DEVELOPER's plans - what is supposed to be built. 'floor plan_1/2/3.jpg' are MEASURED plans of real, completed flats of a similar configuration in the same series.
source_provenance_2026_09_04.no_further_data_until: the building is completed - owner's estimate 2-3 months from 2026-09-04, i.e. roughly 2026-11 to 2026-12. Until then NOTHING can be field-verified and every layout decision rests on design intent.
source_provenance_2026_09_04.mirroring: !! A COMPARABLE MAY BE MIRRORED. The series is built in left- and right-handed variants, so a measured plan can be the horizontal flip of this flat. The LAYOUT is the same; the HANDEDNESS may not be. Consequence: a comparable's dimension may be compared with the same NAMED dimension of this flat, but a comparable's POSITION must never be mapped onto this flat without first establishing handedness. Not previously recorded anywhere.
source_provenance_2026_09_04.precision_limit: Owner: the measured plans are good to about a CENTIMETRE, not a millimetre. Consistent with the +/-25 mm band already derived here, and a reason not to read significance into any single 10 mm difference.
source_provenance_2026_09_04.method_the_owner_endorses: Take the developer's detailed plan as the starting point, and use the three measured plans to bound the likely error on any dimension by comparing the same named dimension across them.

developer_vs_measured_linear_2026_09_04.question: The owner states the real flats come out slightly SMALLER than the developer's plan. The rooms_m2 table above appears to say the opposite - measured AREAS read larger. Both were tested.
developer_vs_measured_linear_2026_09_04.method: Two developer dimensions whose chains are fully PRINTED on the detailed plan, compared with the same named dimension in all three measured plans. 9 comparisons.
developer_vs_measured_linear_2026_09_04.result: DIRECTION IS UNANIMOUS across all 9 comparisons: the developer plan reads LARGER. Magnitude +30 to +110 mm, i.e. +1.0% to +1.9%, mean +1.5%. This supports the owner's recollection, and it is a comparison nobody had made - the tolerance_summary above measures flat-to-FLAT scatter (0-50 mm), not developer-versus-built. !! EXTENDED 2026-09-04 to 12 comparisons across THREE dimensions (middle room length, middle room bottom width, small room width), every one in the same direction, +1.0% to +1.9%.
developer_vs_measured_linear_2026_09_04.unresolved_tension: !! RESOLVED SAME DAY - see AREAS_ARE_NOT_EVIDENCE_2026_09_04. The tension was between a unanimous linear signal and a contradicting AREA signal. Areas are now known not to be reproducible from the printed geometry except for a plain rectangle, and the middle room - the source of the tension - is one of the rooms that fails to close (17.37 computed against 16.64 printed, +4.4%). The area counter-signal is therefore accounted for, and the linear finding stands. Text kept as written so the reasoning is auditable.
developer_vs_measured_linear_2026_09_04.what_would_settle_it: A field measurement of this flat, available only once the building completes. Failing that, one dimension of a measured plan whose own chain is fully printed and unambiguously spans the same wall-to-wall run as a printed developer chain.
developer_vs_measured_linear_2026_09_04.design_consequence_which_holds_either_wa: !! The +/-25 mm SYMMETRIC band understates the downside. Under either reading, size nothing tight from the drawing: assume a room-scale run may come out up to about 100 mm SHORTER than drawn, and never up to 100 mm longer. Practically: no full-wall built-in without a scribe (already the rule), and for a fitted run specify to a site measurement taken after plastering rather than to the plan.

AREAS_ARE_NOT_EVIDENCE_2026_09_04.instruction: OWNER'S STANDING INSTRUCTION, 2026-09-04: do NOT trust area figures - including the developer's own, on either drawing. Use ONLY linear dimensions as the source of truth for geometry. His reasons: he tried to reconstruct the total from the detailed and the general plan and the numbers did not play out; the areas look like a product of recalculation in CAD; and many walls are of complex shape rather than a straight run, which is where the error gets in.

test_run_against_the_printed_chains.method: For every room where BOTH the area and enough of the linear chain are printed on the detailed plan, compare the printed area with the product of the printed dimensions.
test_run_against_the_printed_chains.finding: THE OWNER'S ACCOUNT IS CONFIRMED, AND THE PATTERN IS EXACTLY HIS EXPLANATION: the ONE plain rectangle closes to 0.2%; both rooms with any shape complexity are out by 2.6% and 4.4%. So a printed area cannot be reproduced from the printed geometry of the same room except in the trivial case.

rules: GEOMETRY IS BUILT FROM LINEAR DIMENSIONS ONLY. Never derive, infer or adjust a wall position from an area.

NEVER VALIDATE A RECONSTRUCTION AGAINST A PRINTED AREA. When v0 geometry is built from the chains, its computed room areas WILL differ from the printed ones, and will not sum to 69.09. THAT IS EXPECTED, NOT A BUG - do not 'fix' the geometry to hit the published figure.

USE CHAIN CLOSURE AS THE VALIDATOR INSTEAD. Where a room prints two parallel chains they must agree. Demonstrated on the small room: top 1795+120+910 = 2825 and bottom 1120+1380+150+175 = 2825, exact. That is a real check on the reading, and it is the one to use.

AREAS REMAIN THE PUBLISHED/NOMINAL FIGURES and keep their existing roles - the 69.09 total, the sale documentation, the clear-vs-gross comparison with the БТИ-style plans. They are what the developer PUBLISHES, not a description of the building. Keep them; do not let them drive anything geometric.
AREAS_ARE_NOT_EVIDENCE_2026_09_04.consequence_for_the_open_tension: !! THIS SETTLES developer_vs_measured_linear_2026_09_04, WHICH WAS LEFT OPEN THE DAY BEFORE. That entry recorded a unanimous linear signal (developer reads +1.0% to +1.9% larger, 9 of 9) against a contradicting AREA signal (measured areas read slightly larger), and declined to promote the finding because the two disagreed. The contradicting side is now known to be the unreliable one, and the middle room - the very room whose area caused the tension - is one of the two that fails to close. So the linear bias stands on the linear evidence, and it gains a THIRD independent instance: small room width, developer 2825 against measured 2780-2790, i.e. +35 to +45 mm (+1.25% to +1.62%), the same magnitude and direction as the other two. Twelve comparisons across three dimensions, all one way.
AREAS_ARE_NOT_EVIDENCE_2026_09_04.confidence: Still not a field measurement of this flat, and none is possible until the building completes (~2026-11 to 2026-12). But the counter-evidence is explained rather than outstanding, so this moves from 'unresolved tension, do not promote' to 'supported by 12 of 12 linear comparisons, with the area counter-signal accounted for'.
